question: Top 5 de concesiones por cantidad de posibles venteos satelitales desde 2024, según el contorno de la concesión.

attempts.query:
WITH pts AS (
  SELECT c.id_concesion, c.areapermisoconcesion, p.ord::int AS k,
         (p.v->>0)::float8 AS x, (p.v->>1)::float8 AS y
  FROM sig_energia.concesion c,
       jsonb_array_elements(c.anillo::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY AS p(v, ord)
  WHERE c.anillo IS NOT NULL
),
n AS (SELECT id_concesion, count(*) AS n FROM pts GROUP BY id_concesion),
edges AS (
  SELECT a.id_concesion, a.areapermisoconcesion, a.x AS x1, a.y AS y1, b.x AS x2, b.y AS y2
  FROM pts a JOIN n USING (id_concesion)
  JOIN pts b ON b.id_concesion = a.id_concesion AND b.k = (a.k % n.n) + 1
),
bbox AS (
  SELECT id_concesion, min(x) xmin, max(x) xmax, min(y) ymin, max(y) ymax FROM pts GROUP BY id_concesion
),
v AS (SELECT gml_id, lon, lat FROM sig_energia.venteo_detectado WHERE fecha >= DATE '2024-01-01'),
cand AS (
  SELECT b.id_concesion, v.gml_id, v.lon, v.lat
  FROM bbox b JOIN v ON v.lon BETWEEN b.xmin AND b.xmax AND v.lat BETWEEN b.ymin AND b.ymax
),
inside AS (
  SELECT c.id_concesion, c.gml_id
  FROM cand c JOIN edges e ON e.id_concesion = c.id_concesion
  WHERE (e.y1 > c.lat) <> (e.y2 > c.lat)
    AND c.lon < (e.x2 - e.x1) * (c.lat - e.y1) / (e.y2 - e.y1) + e.x1
  GROUP BY c.id_concesion, c.gml_id
  HAVING count(*) % 2 = 1
)
SELECT max(co.areapermisoconcesion) AS concesion
FROM inside i JOIN sig_energia.concesion co ON co.id_concesion = i.id_concesion
GROUP BY i.id_concesion
ORDER BY count(*) DESC
LIMIT 5
